selection_basis: Exercise materially different official publication and acquisition mechanisms after the national-source inventory; selection is not capture, rights clearance or legal-status qualification.

councils.selection_rationale: Paged service metadata and feature acquisition exercise the existing ArcGIS capture adapter and an already bounded one-feature archive slice.
Separate operative and proposed hosted ePlans exercise application discovery, map/text association and version/status boundaries rather than a direct feature API.
Individually downloadable planning-map PDFs exercise document enumeration, stable file identity and map-sheet coverage without pretending that raster pages are vector features.
The council exposes a data-download catalogue alongside an online resource-management plan, exercising catalogue-to-plan identity links and distinct spatial/document status.

required_capture_evidence_per_council: exact source bytes and retrieval receipts
publication, operative, valid and superseded time assertions
non_claims: Discovery and selection do not establish source completeness, currency, operative legal status or redistribution permission.
The four selected mechanisms are an acquisition test frame, not a nationally representative council sample.
No live planning interpretation or legal advice is produced.
